examples.reading: ともだちにあいにいく。
examples.gloss: I am going to meet my friend.
I went to see a film.

examples.japanese: 本を借りに行ってきます。
examples.reading: ほんをかりにいってきます。
examples.gloss: I am off to borrow a book.

usage: The purpose of the movement. With a noun, say the noun directly: 買い物に行く.
With する verbs the stem is し: 勉強しに行く.

compare.difference: ために states a goal of any kind. に行く states what you go to do.
に来る is the same pattern for coming instead of going.
